Description: The system shall compute triage severity scores from intake vitals and dynamically order the ER bed allocation waitlist.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Higher-acuity patient automatically moves ahead of lower-acuity patient. Fail: FIFO queue ignores critical emergency.
Rationale: Ensures patients with more severe conditions receive priority for ER bed allocation.

Description: The system shall display the real-time occupancy and status of ER and ICU beds as Available, Occupied, or Cleaning.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: A bed-status change is reflected on the dashboard within 1 second. Fail: The dashboard continues showing the previous bed status after 1 second.
Rationale: Helps nurses and administrators make accurate bed-allocation decisions using current availability information.

Description: The system shall allow the Triage Nurse to allocate an available ER or ICU bed to a patient based on triage priority and bed suitability.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: A suitable available bed is assigned and its status changes to Occupied. Fail: The system assigns an unavailable or unsuitable bed.
Rationale: Ensures patients are assigned appropriate beds efficiently.

Description: The system shall allow the Hospital Administrator to initiate and monitor inter-facility ambulance transfer workflows.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: A transfer request records the destination facility, ambulance status, and transfer progress. Fail: Any required transfer information is missing.
Rationale: Supports coordinated and trackable patient transfers between healthcare facilities.

Description: The system shall generate alerts when ICU capacity is critically low or a high-severity patient is waiting for an appropriate bed.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: An alert is displayed when the configured ICU capacity or patient-severity condition is reached. Fail: No alert is generated when the condition occurs.
Rationale: Helps staff respond quickly to critical capacity and patient-priority situations.

Description: The system shall propagate bed status transitions (Occupied, Cleaning, Available) to all connected ER dashboard clients in under 1 second via WebSockets.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Benchmarking confirms that bed-status updates reach connected clients in under 1 second under simulated peak load. Fail: The update takes 1 second or longer.
Rationale: Ensures hospital staff have timely and consistent bed availability information.

Description: The system shall maintain accurate bed and patient allocation information during normal and peak operating conditions.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: System testing shows 100% of completed bed allocations are correctly recorded without data loss or conflicting bed assignments. Fail: Any completed allocation is lost or results in conflicting assignments.
Rationale: Prevents incorrect allocation decisions caused by inconsistent or lost information.
